body.name: \(\Delta_{\mathrm{lift}}(P)\)
body.def: The minimum of \(\operatorname{dist}(a_p,\partial[-1/2,1/2]^2)\), \(\operatorname{dist}(a_T,\partial[-1/2,1/2]^2)\), \(\inf_x\operatorname{dist}((x,p(x)),\operatorname{Cut}_{\mathbb T})\), and \(\inf_y\operatorname{dist}((y,T(y)),\operatorname{Cut}_{\mathbb T})\).
